description: Writes and reviews phased, executable, verifiable, reviewable, rollback-aware software engineering plans with plan-to-code completeness and benefit validation evidence for implementation, refactor, migration, rollout, bug-fix, performance, security, and DevOps work.

changes: Require plans to state expected benefits in addition to implementation deliverables.
Separate correctness validation from benefit validation in plan acceptance criteria.
Add benefit validation tables for metrics, baselines, targets, measurement methods, data sources, observation windows, and pass/fail thresholds.
Add benefit-focused fixtures, exemplar coverage, and sanity checks.
